The '''Corg system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="TEA" /> that contained at least two [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]]. Although the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] were considered to be perilous, they were explored and charted by the [[Morellian]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Barosa Warren]] and [[Casti Tholon]], his [[Human/Legends|Human]] student at the [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]],<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Corg system was first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it within grid square O-20.<ref name="TEA" />
